name: Bournemouth
note: Ireland's data-centre growth curve replayed on Bournemouth. Capacities and money are game units; demand growth and survey rates come from the supplied data (see real_world_data.json and survey.json).
residents_note: Roughly the population of Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole, spread evenly over residential tiles.
site_cost_note: Game assumptions: open land is cheaper to acquire, industrial land is the baseline and town-centre land costs more. These are not Bournemouth land-price measurements.
quiz_reward_note: Game assumptions: a correct answer earns 10% of current gross monthly income and 1 acceptance point; a wrong answer loses 5% and 1.5 acceptance points.
